primitives.name: Referral LTV Premium
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Schmitt, Skiera & Van den Bulte (2011) Referral LTV Premium:** Referred subscribers exhibit an **18% lower monthly churn hazard** ($0.82\times$) and **+16% to +25% higher net LTV** than non-referred cohorts.

primitives.breakdown_regime: At extreme churn levels where customer attrition exceeds retention capacity.

layer2.mapping: Valuation sensitivity kernel derived from BG/NBD model and applied to GSE's risk-adjusted return forecasting.
layer2.telemetry: Quarterly enterprise value changes correlated with monthly churn trends.
